title: Trade Account Application Page

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.name: ta_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small line above the title. Defaults to "Trade Accounts".

fields.label: Hero Intro
fields.name: ta_intro
fields.instructions: One or two sentences under the title.

fields.label: What Happens Next
fields.name: ta_steps
fields.instructions: The numbered list beside the form. Three or four short steps works best — leave it empty to hide the whole column.

fields.label: Side Note
fields.name: ta_note
fields.instructions: Optional small print under the steps — how long review takes, who to call, what to have ready.

fields.label: Hero Background Image
fields.name: ta_hero_bg_image
fields.instructions: Sits behind the page title. Leave empty for the plain dark banner. Use a wide image — at least 1920px.

fields.label: Hero Background Video
fields.name: ta_hero_bg_video
fields.instructions: An MP4 that plays behind the title. Muted and looped so browsers allow it to autoplay. The image above is used as its poster.

fields.label: Background Darkness
fields.name: ta_hero_bg_overlay
fields.instructions: 0-100. How dark the tint over the image/video is, so the white text stays readable. Leave empty for the default (55).

description: Wording around the trade account application. The form itself is built in inc/trade-application.php — the page editor content shows above the steps.
